daily.title: Australia's Rugby League World Cup squad is a sign of the changing times
daily.summary: Kevin Walters pulls off a few surprises in his Australian squad for the Rugby League World Cup, but the side he will try and lead to glory is proof we are in a new era for Test football.

daily.title: The sadistic online cult with a global network that's targeting Australian kids
daily.summary: The FBI calls this type of online cult "modern-day terrorism". They are sadistic, manipulative, target children to commit horrific acts and have found their way to Australia.

daily.title: IS-linked Australians in Iraq face 'risk of unfair prosecution', HRW warns
daily.summary: Human Rights Watch is warning 13 Australians believed to be held in Iraqi jails on suspicion of links to the Islamic State group face inhumane treatment and potential execution.

daily.title: Samoan PM apologises for 'heil Hitler' salute at family event in 2007
daily.summary: Laaulialemalietoa Leuatea Schmidt apologises after video emerges of him performing a Nazi salute and saying the phrase "heil Hitler" at a family event in 2007.

daily.title: NBL owner pays state $577 a week to rent stadium
daily.summary: The Tasmanian government has effectively been leasing out a stadium to property developer and NBL owner Larry Kestelman for less than it would cost to rent most houses in the area, a parliamentary report has found.

daily.title: Nobel Peace Prize won't go to Trump this year, experts say
daily.summary: It is often regarded as the most prestigious of all Nobel prizes, which are given to those who have "conferred the greatest benefit to mankind". But the Nobel Peace Prize can also be controversial.

daily.title: Illegal tobacco crackdown in Victoria has come too late, says ex-policeman
daily.summary: Premier Ben Carroll has conceded the Victorian government should have acted sooner on illegal tobacco but insisted progress had been made since the new enforcement powers came into effect.

daily.title: Yemen's government declares major operation against Houthis
daily.summary: The Yemeni president says the military is working to recapture vast parts of the country from the Houthis, who have withstood a series of attacks from Saudi Arabia, the UAE and their Western allies over the years.

daily.title: Cowboys and girls dress up for Santa Teresa/Ltyentye Apurte horse races
daily.summary: In this remote corner of central Australia, the Santa Teresa/Ltyentye Apurte horse races are a dusty affair with the best in cowboy fashion.

daily.title: NT man caught driving 100km/h over speed limit
daily.summary: Northern Territory Police have charged a man with speeding and high-range drink driving after catching him allegedly driving at more than 100km/h over the limit before returning a blood-alcohol result of 0.153.

daily.title: He was the best forward in the grand final, but Whyte's best is yet to come
daily.summary: Naufahu Whyte wouldn't have looked out of place should he have won the Clive Churchill Medal after the Roosters' grand final victory, and the Tricolours prop is adamant we have yet to see his best.

daily.title: Rising rates could 'bite' into Australian super, Bank of America warns
daily.summary: Interest rates are approaching levels that would hurt Australia's economy and the retirement savings managed by major superannuation funds, according to the Bank of America's head of interest rates strategy.

daily.title: Yeo makes World Cup call, Walker earns Kangaroos spot
daily.summary: The grand final sides feature in the Kangaroos squad for the Rugby League World Cup, with James Tedesco back in and Sydney's Sam Walker and Newcastle's Bradman Best among six debutants.

daily.title: New movie corrects the record on Tenzing Norgay's Everest climb
daily.summary: Australian filmmaker Jennifer Peedom fell in love with the Himalayas as a young woman. She is now retelling its most famous story.

daily.title: Bolsonaro defies expectations in Brazil presidential vote to face Lula in run-off
daily.summary: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the far-right former leader Jair Bolsonaro, has finished ahead of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the country's election, which will go to a run-off in three weeks.

daily.title: Tom Cruise movie Digger bombs at box office, Verity takes top spot
daily.summary: Movie star Tom Cruise suffers one of the worst debuts of his career with his new movie Digger.

daily.title: Property downturn worsens with less than 50pc of auctions leading to a sale
daily.summary: Australia's auction clearance rate has slumped to a three-month low, while new data shows the number of unsold homes has surged by more than 20 per cent in the past year.

daily.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into airport, Israeli media reports
daily.summary: The flydubai co-pilot allegedly tells investigators he intended to continue flying normally before crashing into the main airport in Israel.

daily.title: Man fatally shot by police after crashing car into tree
daily.summary: An independent review by the Professional Standards Command will be conducted after a man was fatally shot by NSW police near Yass on Sunday.

daily.title: Fire destroys abandoned mental health hospital building near Hobart
daily.summary: Millbrook Rise opened in 1934, initially to provide care to those returning from war. The original building has been abandoned for several years.

daily.title: 'We'll be there': Fans rally behind Knights after grand final loss
daily.summary: Despite Sunday's loss against the Roosters, Newcastle Knights fans remain proud of the team's effort.

daily.title: As China tensions escalate, Japan builds its own spy agency
daily.summary: Japan may soon have its own "CIA", with the nation working with "the utmost urgency" to establish its first centralised network of intelligence operations since World War II.

daily.title: Mary Fowler's Man City boost with big WSL win over Arsenal
daily.summary: Mary Fowler's landmark 100th game for Manchester City is a bright spot for the beleaguered club, with a big win over Arsenal keeping them with a perfect record on top of the WSL.

daily.title: Driver arrested for allegedly ramming rideshare vehicle, road closed after hills crash
daily.summary: A 19-year-old driver who allegedly rammed a rideshare vehicle has been arrested, with SA Police also responding to several other long weekend crashes. Road closures are in place after a crash in Castambul, north-east of Adelaide.

daily.title: 'Don't drop it': Star's nervous moment as Roosters celebrate in Bondi
daily.summary: Grand final hero Mark Nawaqanitawase lifts the Provan-Summons trophy to adoring fans as his coach describes the Roosters star as "extraordinary".
